prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Sports Dynamic Web App
I want to create a sports motivation web app and need a full stack developer to ramp up the release. It combines great video collaboration and editing tools with a discussion forum. What I’m looking for: - An experienced developer who has worked in Objective-C - Marking up video tool with compression & transcoding - Photo and video sharing (AWS) About the project timeline: - this project would likely be a few weeks of ~20 hrs/week to get out a few features we have ready. If we enjoy working together, I'd love to be able to extend the offer for the next 3-12+ months (less hours per week) as we iterate and release new versions. Requirements: - 2-5+ years web application experience - very strong English skills Nice-to-haves: - Experience with video, playing videos, editing videos, uploading videos, etc. - Experience with social media applications. Please share a brief summary of your experience and tell us about a recent iOS project, ideally one currently available on the App Store.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a full stack developer to help ramp up a sports motivation web app, especially around video collaboration/editing, discussion features, and photo/video sharing.  

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I bring 7 years of experience building web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, and full stack development, plus strong HTML and CSS. I’m comfortable working across frontend and backend to help ship features quickly and iterate as the product grows.  

I noticed you mentioned Objective-C and would be glad to discuss how that fits into the work, along with the video tooling and AWS-based sharing needs. I can also work in a focused weekly cadence for the initial feature push and continue longer term if it’s a good fit.  

What are the first few features you want to prioritize for the initial release?
